newsitem.title: USA: U.S soldier charged with attempted murder.
newsitem.headline: U.S soldier charged with attempted murder.

text.p: Military authorities have charged a soldier in the 82nd Airborne Division based at Fort Bragg with the attempted murder of two civilians, the army said on Friday.
Private Michael Gurley is being held at Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, while investigations continue into the shooting incident at Fort Bragg Dec. 19.
He also faces additional charges of conspiracy to commit aggravated assault, wrongful discharge of a firearm, and unlawfully carrying a concealed weapon, an army statement said.
